raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Summary

Implements the admission part of RFC #47289:

- add opt-in `--tbo-admission-policy {always,threshold}` (default `always` keeps current behavior);
- under `threshold`, reject TBO locally when the batch is below `--tbo-prefill-token-threshold` / `--tbo-decode-token-threshold`, or when either child has fewer than `--tbo-min-child-tokens` real tokens or is empty;
- the rejection reuses the existing `local_can_run_tbo` vote, so all DP ranks reach the same decision without a new collective field;
- reject reasons are logged under `SGLANG_TBO_DEBUG`; fallback metrics are left as follow-up;
- validate the new integer args are non-negative;
- add CPU unit coverage for decode, prefill, child minimum, empty child, and `always`.

## Validation

- `python -m py_compile` and `git diff --check` pass.
- Unit tests and a TBO-off vs `threshold` performance / token-equality comparison are pending; results will be added here before marking ready.

Refs #47289

+def _tbo_threshold_reject_reason(
+    *,
+    forward_mode: ForwardMode,
+    num_tokens: int,
+    split_seq_index: int,
+    extend_lens: Optional[Sequence[int]],
+    token_num_per_seq: Optional[int],
+) -> Optional[str]:
+    overlap = get_exec().overlap

+        threshold = overlap.tbo_prefill_token_threshold

+        return "batch_too_small"
+

+        split_seq_index=split_seq_index,
+        forward_mode=forward_mode,
+        extend_seq_lens=extend_lens,
+        token_num_per_seq=token_num_per_seq,
+    )
+    min_child_tokens = min(split_token_index, num_tokens - split_token_index)
+    if min_child_tokens == 0:
+        return "empty_child"
+    if min_child_tokens < overlap.tbo_min_child_tokens:
+        return "child_too_small"
+    return None

+class TestTboAdmissionPolicy(CustomTestCase):
+    def _reject_reason(
+        self,
+        *,
+        num_tokens,
+        threshold,
+        min_child_tokens,
+        policy="threshold",
+        forward_mode=ForwardMode.DECODE,
+        extend_lens=None,
+        split_seq_index=None,
+    ):
+        with get_context().override_server_args(
+            enable_two_batch_overlap=True,
+            tbo_admission_policy=policy,
+            tbo_prefill_token_threshold=threshold,
+            tbo_decode_token_threshold=threshold,
+            tbo_min_child_tokens=min_child_tokens,
+        ):
+            return _tbo_threshold_reject_reason(
+                forward_mode=forward_mode,
+                num_tokens=num_tokens,
+                split_seq_index=(
+                    num_tokens // 2 if split_seq_index is None else split_seq_index
+                ),
+                extend_lens=extend_lens,
+                token_num_per_seq=1 if forward_mode.is_decode() else None,
+            )
+
+    def test_small_batch_is_rejected(self):
+        self.assertEqual(
+            self._reject_reason(num_tokens=8, threshold=16, min_child_tokens=1),
+            "batch_too_small",
+        )
+
+    def test_child_minimum_is_enforced(self):
+        self.assertEqual(
+            self._reject_reason(num_tokens=8, threshold=0, min_child_tokens=8),
+            "child_too_small",
+        )
+
+    def test_empty_child_is_rejected(self):
+        self.assertEqual(
+            self._reject_reason(num_tokens=1, threshold=0, min_child_tokens=0),
+            "empty_child",
+        )
+
+    def test_prefill_uses_prefill_threshold(self):
+        self.assertEqual(
+            self._reject_reason(
+                num_tokens=8,
+                threshold=16,
+                min_child_tokens=1,
+                forward_mode=ForwardMode.EXTEND,
+                extend_lens=[4, 4],
+                split_seq_index=1,
+            ),
+            "batch_too_small",
+        )
+
+    def test_prefill_child_split_uses_extend_lens(self):
+        self.assertEqual(
+            self._reject_reason(
+                num_tokens=20,
+                threshold=16,
+                min_child_tokens=12,
+                forward_mode=ForwardMode.EXTEND,
+                extend_lens=[10, 10],
+                split_seq_index=1,
+            ),
+            "child_too_small",
+        )
+
+    def test_always_policy_preserves_current_admission(self):
+        self.assertIsNone(
+            self._reject_reason(
+                num_tokens=8, threshold=1024, min_child_tokens=1024, policy="always"
+            )
+        )
+
+    def test_balanced_batch_is_admitted(self):
+        self.assertIsNone(
+            self._reject_reason(num_tokens=32, threshold=16, min_child_tokens=8)
+        )
+
